name: Project or Phase Closeout
notes: Landscape pages. The index name is Project or Phase Closeout; the title bar reads PROJECT CLOSEOUT. The title block prints three labels on one row (Project Title, Date Prepared, Project Manager), so the single entry in pairs is a triple. Page 1 is one large box with the label Project Description printed inside its top-left corner. On page 2 the text blocks are printed section headings over tables, not fillable fields; Benefits Management and Business Needs print as headings over boxes. In the Performance Summary and Variances tables the row-label column has no printed header. The Risks and Issues table prints 4 blank rows. Variances prints both as a section heading and as the middle column header of the table under it. Prose Table 5.2 treats Risks and issues as one summary element; the blank form prints it as a three-column table.
